def read(name):
 raw=(ROOT/name).read_bytes()
 return json.loads(raw),hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

plan,plan_hash=read('artifact-metadata/plan.json')

assert data['plan']==plan and plan['runtimeCommit']=='5048ba3e8a65fc41b9ae898c47b54d5731cd759e'
assert data['failures']==[] and data['inFlight'] is None
assert data['compressionWorkersFinalState']=={'workerCount':4,'allTerminated':True,'failure':None}
assert len(data['observations'])==36 and len(data['warmups'])==3 and len(data['sourceOwnershipChecks'])==3 and len(data['exhaustiveDecodeVerification'])==42
assert [x['mode'] for x in data['warmups']]==plan['warmupOrder']
rows=[{'round':i,'order':v} for i,v in enumerate(plan['orders'])]
expected=plan['expected']
for ordinal,o in enumerate(data['observations']):
 i=ordinal//3
 assert o['round']==i and o['mode']==plan['orders'][i][ordinal%3] and o['order']==plan['orders'][i]
 elapsed=(int(o['endedNs'])-int(o['startedNs']))/1e6
 assert abs(elapsed-o['elapsedMs'])<1e-12 and elapsed>0
 rows[i][o['mode'][0]]=elapsed
for o in data['warmups']+data['observations']:

 assert all(0<=x['physicalWorker']<4 for x in o['jobs'])

for o in data['sourceOwnershipChecks']:

 assert o['pending']==0 and o['queued']==0 and o['heldReplies']==0
for o in data['exhaustiveDecodeVerification']:
 assert o['blocks'] in (10,103) and o['decodedBytes'] in (9506472,100300626)
# Each metric uses the same twelve round draws, exactly as prospectively registered.
comparisons={}
for control in ('A','C'):
 ms=[r['B']-r[control] for r in rows]
 pct=[(r['B']/r[control]-1)*100 for r in rows]
 bt=sum(r['B'] for r in rows);ct=sum(r[control] for r in rows)
 comparisons['B/'+control]={'differencesMs':ms,'differencesPercent':pct,'medianDifferenceMs':statistics.median(ms),'medianDifferencePercent':statistics.median(pct),'fasterPairs':sum(x<0 for x in ms),'candidateTotalMs':bt,'controlTotalMs':ct,'equalWorkChangePercent':(bt/ct-1)*100}
metrics=[comparisons['B/A']['differencesMs'],comparisons['B/A']['differencesPercent'],comparisons['B/C']['differencesMs'],comparisons['B/C']['differencesPercent']]
state=0x000da6c4
resampled=[[],[],[],[]]
for repeat in range(20000):
 draw=[]
 for _ in range(12):
  state=(state^((state<<13)&0xffffffff))&0xffffffff
  state=(state^(state>>17))&0xffffffff
  state=(state^((state<<5)&0xffffffff))&0xffffffff
  draw.append(math.floor(state/4294967296*12))
 for k,v in enumerate(metrics):resampled[k].append(statistics.median(v[i] for i in draw))
def quantile(v,p):
 pos=(len(v)-1)*p;lo=math.floor(pos);hi=math.ceil(pos)
 return v[lo]+(v[hi]-v[lo])*(pos-lo)
intervals=[]
for v in resampled:
 v.sort();intervals.append([quantile(v,.025),quantile(v,.975)])
def near(a,b):return abs(a-b)<1e-9
for i,key in enumerate(('B/A','B/C')):
 c=comparisons[key];ref=reported['result']['comparisons'][key]
 c['medianDifferenceMs95']=intervals[2*i];c['medianDifferencePercent95']=intervals[2*i+1]
 c['mechanicalPass']=(c['medianDifferenceMs']<=-5 and c['medianDifferencePercent']<=-5 and c['fasterPairs']>=9 and c['candidateTotalMs']<c['controlTotalMs'] and c['medianDifferenceMs95'][1]<0 and c['medianDifferencePercent95'][1]<0)
 assert near(c['medianDifferenceMs'],-ref['pairedMedianSavingMs']) and near(c['medianDifferencePercent'],-ref['pairedMedianSavingPercent'])
 assert c['fasterPairs']==ref['fasterPairs'] and near(c['equalWorkChangePercent'],ref['equalWorkChangePercent'])
 for v,w in zip(c['medianDifferenceMs95'],ref['pairedMedianDifferenceMs95']):assert near(v,w)
 for v,w in zip(c['medianDifferencePercent95'],ref['pairedMedianDifferencePercent95']):assert near(v,w)
ca=[(r['C']/r['A']-1)*100 for r in rows]
control_median=statistics.median(ca)
drift_limit=min(abs(comparisons['B/A']['medianDifferencePercent']),abs(comparisons['B/C']['medianDifferencePercent']))/2
assert near(control_median,reported['result']['control']['pairedMedianPercent'])
assert state==1110904116==reported['result']['bootstrap']['finalState']
advance=all(c['mechanicalPass'] for c in comparisons.values()) and abs(control_median)<drift_limit
assert advance is False and reported['result']['advance'] is False
